description.zh: OpenAI 提出 DALL-E，这是一种基于 Transformer、从文本描述生成图像的系统。它让文生图成为面向公众展示语言模型如何控制视觉合成的重要案例。
description.en: OpenAI introduced DALL-E as a transformer-based system that generated images from text descriptions. It made text-to-image generation a public-facing demonstration of how language models could control visual synthesis.

role.zh: DALL-E 主要作者与创建者
role.en: Lead author and creator of DALL-E

notes.en: Retained in Archive but excluded from the canonical long-term BenchCouncil AI100 storyline because it is not listed in the root-page achievement table retrieved on 2026-07-30.
notes.zh: 保留在 Archive 中，但因未列入 2026-07-30 获取的 BenchCouncil 根页面长期成就主表，已从 canonical AI100 分支移出。
